bulk_operations_counts_check.name: bulk_operations_counts_check
bulk_operations_counts_check.value: processed <= total and succeeded + failed <= processed

signup_codes_uses_check.name: signup_codes_uses_check
signup_codes_uses_check.value: uses >= 0 and uses <= max_uses and max_uses between 1 and 1000

devices_battery_check.name: devices_battery_check
devices_battery_check.value: battery_pct is null or battery_pct between 0 and 100

events_category_check.name: events_category_check
events_category_check.value: category is null or category in ('arts_culture', 'business_seminars', 'charity', 'community', 'education_classes', 'family', 'food_drink', 'health_wellness', 'music', 'nightlife', 'religion_spirituality', 'social_gatherings', 'sports_fitness', 'technology', 'travel_leisure', 'other')

orders_totals_check.name: orders_totals_check
orders_totals_check.value: subtotal_minor >= 0 and fee_minor >= 0 and total_minor = subtotal_minor + fee_minor

orders_payment_method_check.name: orders_payment_method_check
orders_payment_method_check.value: payment_method is null or payment_method in ('cash', 'zelle', 'card_terminal', 'other')

refunds_amount_check.name: refunds_amount_check
refunds_amount_check.value: amount_minor > 0 and fee_refunded_minor between 0 and amount_minor

settlements_amounts_check.name: settlements_amounts_check
settlements_amounts_check.value: released_minor >= 0 and reserve_minor >= 0 and netted_minor >= 0 and amount_minor >= 0 and amount_minor = released_minor - reserve_minor - netted_minor

event_seats_block_check.name: event_seats_block_check
event_seats_block_check.value: (status = 'blocked') = (block_reason is not null) and (block_reason is null or block_reason in ('channel', 'ada', 'kill', 'assigned'))

event_seats_hold_check.name: event_seats_hold_check
event_seats_hold_check.value: (status = 'held') = (hold_id is not null and hold_expires_at is not null)

seat_assignments_prior_block_check.name: seat_assignments_prior_block_check
seat_assignments_prior_block_check.value: prior_block is null or prior_block in ('channel', 'ada')

invitations_org_email_pending_key.name: invitations_org_email_pending_key
invitations_org_email_pending_key.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

org_domains_hostname_check.name: org_domains_hostname_check
org_domains_hostname_check.value: hostname = lower(hostname) and length(hostname) between 4 and 253 and hostname ~ '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?([.][a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$'

promo_codes_value_check.name: promo_codes_value_check
promo_codes_value_check.value: (kind = 'percent' and percent_bps between 1 and 10000 and amount_minor is null) or (kind = 'amount' and amount_minor > 0 and percent_bps is null)

promo_codes_redemptions_check.name: promo_codes_redemptions_check
promo_codes_redemptions_check.value: redeemed_count >= 0 and (max_redemptions is null or (max_redemptions >= 1 and redeemed_count <= max_redemptions))

promo_codes_window_check.name: promo_codes_window_check
promo_codes_window_check.value: ends_at is null or starts_at is null or ends_at > starts_at

ticket_claims_org_ticket_open_key.name: ticket_claims_org_ticket_open_key
ticket_claims_org_ticket_open_key.where: claimed_at is null and revoked_at is null

ticket_types_inventory_check.name: ticket_types_inventory_check
ticket_types_inventory_check.value: quantity_sold >= 0 and quantity_held >= 0 and quantity_sold + quantity_held <= quantity_total

ticket_types_window_check.name: ticket_types_window_check
ticket_types_window_check.value: sales_end_at is null or sales_start_at is null or sales_end_at > sales_start_at

ticket_types_early_check.name: ticket_types_early_check
ticket_types_early_check.value: (early_price_minor is null) = (early_ends_at is null) and (early_price_minor is null or (early_price_minor >= 0 and early_price_minor < price_minor))

ticket_types_donation_check.name: ticket_types_donation_check
ticket_types_donation_check.value: not is_donation or early_price_minor is null

venues_geo_check.name: venues_geo_check
venues_geo_check.value: (latitude is null) = (longitude is null) and (latitude is null or (latitude between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180))
